uplink.description: work mode 1 (2ACI+2AVI): AVI1 1.195 V, ACI1 4.88 mA, DI1 closed
uplink._note: TTN example input. byte[10]=0x01 -> hardware 0 (LT33222), mode 1. AVI1=s16(0x04AB)=1195/1000=1.195 V, ACI1=s16(0x1310)=4880/1000=4.88 mA. byte[8]=0xAA: DI1(bit3)=1 closed, DI2(bit4)=0, DI3(bit5)=1, DO1 H, DO2 L, DO3 H, RO1 ON, RO2 OFF. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (AVI1_V 1.195, ACI1_mA 4.88, DI1 'H', DI2 'L', DI3 'H').

uplink.description: work mode 2 (Count mode 1): two cumulative counters
uplink._note: byte[10]=0x02 -> mode 2. Count1=0x000003E8=1000 -> pulse.count, Count2=0x000007D0=2000 -> count2. byte[8]=0 so all DO high / RO off. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (Count1_times 1000, Count2_times 2000).
